title: Sherpa voice Cohere Transcribe download + bridge roundtrip
description: Downloads the Cohere Transcribe 14-lang int8 model (~1.58 GB tar.bz2, extracts to ~2.7 GB) on-device via __AGENTIC__.downloadModel, polls until status === 'downloaded', then runs the testASR('cohere', _, 'en') roundtrip with English `test_wavs/en.wav`. Validates the new `language` / `usePunct` / `useItn` plumbing through the wrapper handlers.

prepare-ready-0.intent: The sherpa-voice app is running with the agentic bridge installed.
